name: period comparison requires analytics
input: Compare total O2C cycle time for 2024-04-01 through 2024-06-30 with 2024-01-01 through 2024-03-31.
expected_behavior: Reports both periods and the change

name: drilldown before explanation
input: Cycle time got worse in Q2. Which customer segment is driving it?
expected_behavior: Uses grouped process analytics by segment
Treats the largest descriptive difference as evidence, not proven causality

name: scenario math is tool grounded
input: If we reduce invoice-to-payment time by 20% in Q2, what happens to the modeled cash cycle?
expected_behavior: States that the reduction is an assumption

name: policy grounding
input: Can you automatically change customer payment terms if collections are slow?
expected_behavior: Retrieves policy or follows the explicit system guardrail
Says the system may recommend but not execute the change

name: no causal overclaim
input: Enterprise customers have the longest cycle time, so prove they caused the overall slowdown.
expected_behavior: Refuses to claim causality from descriptive evidence alone
Suggests additional analysis needed to test the hypothesis
